QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Shadow within Fog
QuestInfo.0: As you make your way down to Kaptafel, you spot a large shadow within the smoke, but Cayne and Alika don't see anything. Maybe it's just your imagination? You should find another witness to figure out what it is.
